a: PINAL COUNTY COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT WILL OPERATE A TRIO UPWARD BOUND PROJECT SERVING 60 PARTICIPANTS IN THE TARGET AREAS OF COOLIDGE, CASA GRANDE, AND GILA RIVER INDIAN COMMUNITY.
PINAL COUNTY COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT, A.KA. CENTRAL ARIZONA COLLEGE, IS PROPOSING A TITLE V PROJECT TO IMPROVE THE ACADEMIC OUTCOMES OF HISPANIC, LOW-INCOME, AND OTHER UNDER-REPRESENTED STUDENTS.
A TRIO STUDENT SUPPORT SERVICES PROJECT SERVING 160 SSS-ELIGIBLE PARTICIPANTS AT CENTRAL ARIZONA COLLEGE
CENTRAL ARIZONA COLLEGE'S TRIO STUDENT SUPPORT SERVICES (SSS) PROJECT WILL SERVE 160 SSS-ELIGIBLE STUDENTS ANNUALLY.
THIS TITLE V PROJECT WILL ESTABLISH GUIDED PATHWAYS, STRUCTURED ACADEMIC ADVISING AND REFORMED DEVELOPMENTAL MATH AT CAC TO FOSTER GREATER STUDENT RETENTION, GRADUATION, AND TRANSFER.
